description: Shop across merchants through the Universal Commerce Protocol

interface.longDescription:
Shop helps you find products and get to checkout without leaving the conversation. Describe what you want, or name a brand or product you already like, and Shop searches its catalog of merchants. It compares options with prices, sellers, sizes, colors, and images, and links every recommendation to the merchant's product page.

When you're ready to buy, Shop can save a cart or prepare a checkout with the merchant and give you a link to review and pay. It never places an order without your approval.

Signing in is optional. Connect your Shop account to personalize results, use your saved addresses at checkout, and find and track orders in your Shop order history.

Limitations: prices, availability, and shipping come from merchants and can change before checkout. Search can't promise delivery by a specific date; check delivery options at the merchant's checkout. Order lookup covers orders Shop tracks for your account.
